verdict.rationale: Motion advertises Zapier connectivity ('Connect with thousands of the most popular apps using Zapier') and a documented REST API for tasks/projects that a live probe confirms is functioning and auth-gated, which could technically route booking data into Salesforce/HubSpot via Zapier or custom API calls. However, there is no direct native Salesforce/HubSpot integration, no CRM-specific field mapping, and no case study or hands-on evidence of bookings actually flowing into a CRM without manual work. Missing for 10: named Salesforce/HubSpot native connectors, documented booking-to-CRM field mapping, and independent confirmation the Zapier/API path works end-to-end for this specific use case.
